{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# And verify the QA orders

print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_orders_count}')"}
